definitions.explanation: The way of reporting speech or thought in writing, including direct and indirect speech in grammar.

examples.japanese: {直接|ちょくせつ}{話法|わほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00378_tsukau⟧。
{間接|かんせつ}{話法|わほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：00650_kaeru⟧。
{話法|わほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転換|てんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：00770_renshuu⟧。

notes:
{話法|わほう} refers to the grammatical concept of speech modes.

TYPES OF SPEECH:
- {直接|ちょくせつ}{話法|わほう}: direct speech (quoting exactly)
- {間接|かんせつ}{話法|わほう}: indirect speech (reported speech)
- {描出|びょうしゅつ}{話法|わほう}: free indirect speech

USAGE:
- Commonly used in grammar and language education
- Important for understanding narrative techniques

RELATED TERMS:
- {引用|いんよう}: quotation
- {伝聞|でんぶん}: hearsay
- {語法|ごほう}: usage, grammar
